summary: File-based save and load through JsonUtility, as a structured alternative to PlayerPrefs.
overview: Writes a serializable object to a file and reads it back, using Unity's built-in JsonUtility. A structured alternative to PlayerPrefs for anything bigger than a setting. Kept dependency-free on purpose — data JsonUtility cannot handle goes through JsonHelper instead, which is a separate tool so this one needs no package.
useCases: Player progress, inventory contents or level completion.
Any save where PlayerPrefs would mean flattening an object into keys.
A save format you can open and read while debugging.

gotchas.title: JsonUtility cannot serialize Dictionaries, interfaces or polymorphic types
gotchas.body: They come back empty rather than erroring, which looks like data loss. Use JsonHelper for those.

gotchas.title: Files are plain JSON on disk
gotchas.body: Readable while debugging, and equally readable to a player who wants to edit their save. Anything that must not be tampered with needs its own protection.
